# Tax compliance is not the cost of doing business. It is the business.


Learn why leading financial institutions are using tax compliance technology to build confidence, agility and scalable control.


September 23, 2026


Share

For a long time, tax compliance was treated as the thing you dealt with after the real work was done. A box to tick, a team to keep happy, a line in the budget nobody looked forward to. That thinking is quietly falling apart, and honestly, not before time.


Financial services today are shaped by rising regulatory demands, real anxiety around data security, and a growing expectation that institutions can show their working at any moment. It is no longer enough to get tax right. You have to prove it, trace it, and stand behind it across complex, multi-entity structures that rarely sit neatly in one system. For organizations juggling intricate procurement and intercompany flows, that pressure is not abstract. It hinders VAT recovery, it increases risk, and it pulls good people away from the strategic work they should be doing.


This is the part that I think gets missed. Compliance done badly is expensive. Compliance done well is a genuine advantage.


That belief sits at the heart of how we built[Vertex O Series](https://www.vertexinc.com/solutions/products/vertex-indirect-tax-o-series) . Our tax compliance software automates VAT determination using continuously updated tax content across more than 19,000 jurisdictions, so the right treatment is applied at the source, in real time, without someone manually chasing every rule change. It handles reverse charge automation and self-accrual logic for cross-border scenarios, which is exactly where so much audit exposure and manual effort tends to hide. And it does all of this while integrating with the platforms institutions already run, from SAP S/4HANA to Oracle Fusion, so tax logic can flex as the business evolves rather than breaking every time something moves.


## The benefits of tax compliance services


When organizations have access to such a tax control framework, it reframes the whole conversation. Instead of asking how we survive the next audit, our clients start asking what they could do with the time they get back and the accuracy they can rely upon. And the answers are telling. Tax teams are shifting from transactional firefighting to genuine strategy. One client put it simply after moving their custom and Tax Assist rules across, saying they were very pleased with the increased accuracy and the time saved. Others report fewer audit findings and faster resolution, largely because every tax decision can be traced right back to source data. That kind of visibility changes the mood in the room. Audits stop being a threat and start being a formality.


There is a scale story here too, and it matters. One globally recognized financial services giant rolled out O Series to an average of ten countries every four months, moving from a purely US instance to a genuinely global implementation spanning Ireland and much of EMEA and APAC. They described it as scaling at pace without compromising on precision, and that phrase has stuck with me, because precision at pace is the hardest thing to deliver in this space. Most solutions give you one or the other.


Underpinning all of it is nearly 50 years of tax expertise and the trust of over 4,700 businesses, including 60 percent of the Fortune 500, across 195 plus countries. That is the reason our tax content holds up when the rules shift, and the reason FS institutions feel confident handing us something as sensitive as their compliance posture.


## Improving tax compliance confidence


So, when people ask what tax compliance regtech is really for, my answer has become quite simple. Tax technology solutions are where you see it most clearly: an applied, tested use case for regulatory technology, proven daily rather than argued in theory. It is for turning obligation into confidence. It is for giving finance leaders room to think rather than just react. It is for making compliance something you build on, not something you brace for.


Precision, agility, and control, working as one and embedded into the heart of how our clients operate. That is the story the judges at the[FS Awards Dublin 2025](https://fsdublin.com/2025-winners/) recognized when they named Vertex winner in the Best Compliance and RegTech category.
